name: research-extract-buildings
description: Phase 1 of the roof-recon evaluation effort. Slices the disc point cloud + cadastre footprints into per-building records (one record per outer ring, variable-length AK_ARRAY_INLINE). Produces the shared input shape every candidate roof-reconstruction pipeline (PolyFit / KSR / Roofer / V7) consumes. See v3/docs/research/roof-recon-survey.md and v3/docs/OBFUSCATION.md (this pipeline is dev-only — not in EMBEDDED_PIPELINES).
